_source.per_level: vmangos world DB: player_classlevelstats (class=2) for base_health/base_mana; player_crit_per_agility and player_dodge_per_agility (class=2) for the agility divisors. Read by ObjectMgr::LoadPlayerInfo / ObjectMgr::GetPlayerCritPerAgility / GetPlayerDodgePerAgility.
_source.race_base_stats: vmangos world DB: player_levelstats (class=2). Naked base stats per race per level, before gear/buffs. Races vanilla never paired with this Class are synthesised (see _synthesised_races).

_interpolated_note: Levels missing from the vmangos agility tables are filled by linear interpolation between the nearest neighbours, as ObjectMgr::LoadPlayerInfo does. _synthesised_note: orc, night_elf, undead, tauren, gnome, troll: not in player_levelstats for this Class; each is dwarf's rows plus the race's offset from the Warrior rows (player_levelstats class=1).
